name: @asimsinan/sdd-mcp-server
description: Specification-Driven Development MCP Server with AI-Powered Intelligence

scripts.build:lib: tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && cp src/lib/sdd-mcp-server/database/schema*.sql dist/lib/sdd-mcp-server/database/ && mkdir -p dist/bin && chmod +x dist/bin/sdd-mcp-server.js && npm run copy-template-to-dist
scripts.build:with-template: npm run build:lib && npm run install:template
scripts.build:complete: npm run build:lib && npm run copy-template-to-dist && npm run create-prefilled-db
scripts.install:global: npm run build:complete && npm pack && npm install -g asimsinan-sdd-mcp-server-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version").tgz && rm asimsinan-sdd-mcp-server-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version").tgz
scripts.reinstall:global: npm run build:complete && npm pack && npm uninstall -g sdd-mcp && npm install -g asimsinan-sdd-mcp-server-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version").tgz && rm asimsinan-sdd-mcp-server-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version").tgz
scripts.postversion: node -e "const pkg = require('./package.json'); const version = pkg.version; const fs = require('fs'); const files = ['src/templates/spec.json', 'src/templates/plan.json', 'src/templates/status.json', 'src/templates/tasks.json', 'src/templates/clarify.json', 'src/templates/implement.json']; files.forEach(file => { if (fs.existsSync(file)) { const content = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'); const updated = content.replace(/\"version\": \"[\d.]+\"/g, `\"version\": \"${version}\"`); fs.writeFileSync(file, updated); console.log(`Updated ${file} to version ${version}`); } }); console.log('Version updated! Run npm run reinstall:global to install the new version globally.');"

author: Asim Sinan Yuksel
